title: System Orientation
purpose: Build the first mental map: electrical fundamentals, HV source, transformer, LV distribution, UPS purpose, transfer systems and critical loads.

title: Energy Paths
purpose: Ask what can energise each item. Add alternate HV/LV paths, batteries, bypass, couplers and automatic transfer.

title: Operating States
purpose: Recognise that risk and resilience depend on system state: normal, alternate, bypass, battery, coupled, isolated, unavailable or reduced redundancy.

title: Protection & Source Behaviour
purpose: Connect faults, impedance, protection, selectivity and changing source characteristics.

title: Safety Application
purpose: Superimpose operational rules, source identification, stored energy, isolation concepts, verification and stop/challenge behaviour over the whole architecture.

title: Commissioning & Configuration
purpose: Introduce temporary supplies, load banks, inhibited automation, equipment under test and configuration control.

title: Abnormal Operation
purpose: Use unexpected trips, failed transfers, conflicting indications, control failures and loss of redundancy to develop judgement.

title: Integrated Competence
purpose: Remove artificial module boundaries and assess the complete electrical system as an interacting whole.
